THERE WERE DAMAGES DURING THIS INCIDENT, HOWEVER THE PRICE POINT FOR THOSE DAMAGES IS UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER AT THIS TIME. WHEN ASK IF A WATERWAY WAS AFFECTED THE CALLER STATED THAT THEY DID NOT KNOW.
